data.title: 烧盐柠檬 · 盛夏河堤单车的晚霞疾呼
data.description: 丰桥市河堤青草斜坡上，漫天绚烂赤红晚霞将波光粼粼的河面染透。柠檬单脚踏地扶着自行车，迎着凉爽晚风回头向推车的你大声呼喊催促，短发狂飞，笑容烂漫。
data.location: grassy riverside levee path beside shimmering wide river at golden sunset
data.action: standing paused beside road bicycle, one foot on ground, looking back with a wide beaming grin while waving arm enthusiastically against sunset
data.lighting: 河面与天际交融的浓郁黄昏赤金逆光
data.promptProse: Lemon pauses on her bicycle along the grassy river embankment at sunset, laughing and calling back as evening winds sweep across the golden river.
data.animaCaption: The glowing sunset reflects on the river surface as she calls out from beside her bicycle.
